Shell sandbox is blocked, so I'll pull the skill and store guidelines from GitHub and official docs instead.# Rules for native “Rate us” prompts

Cross-platform policy derived from Apple and Google store rules. Treat **platform hard limits** as non-negotiable; treat **app cooldowns / eligibility** as required self-discipline so you don’t burn quota or annoy users.

## 1. Only use the native system prompt

| Platform | API | Hard rule |
|---|---|---|
| **iOS / iPadOS / macOS** | StoreKit `requestReview` / `RequestReviewAction` (legacy: `SKStoreReviewController`) | Custom in-app review prompts are disallowed. Use the system API.[[1]](https://developer.apple.com/app-store/review/guidelines/) |
| **Android** | Google Play In-App Review API (`launchReviewFlow`) | Show the Play card as-is: no redesign, no overlays, no programmatic dismiss.[[2]](https://developer.android.com/guide/playcore/in-app-review) |

**Allowed alternative (user-initiated only):** a settings / help control that opens the store

## Decision contract

| Field | Fill this |
| --- | --- |
| **Hypothesis** | One sentence: “If we do X for Y, they will Z.” |
| **Success signal** | What observation would make you **build**? What would make you **kill**? |
| **Non-goals** | No production hardening, multi-region, abstract platforms, pixel-perfect systems, or permanent architecture. |
| **Time box** | Hours–days, not a delivery program. |
| **Terminal** | Written **go / kill / pivot / need-another-probe** with evidence pointers—not “code exists.” |
